title: Bevacizumab with weekly topotecan
schedule_label: Both on days 1 and 15; topotecan alone on day 8.
schedule_summary: Bevacizumab 10 mg/kg and topotecan 4 mg/m² on days 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle. Topotecan 4 mg/m² alone on day 8. No planned infusion on day 22.
purpose: Slow the growth of recurrent cancer and help control symptoms.
indication_text: Platinum-resistant recurrent epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer. The NCCP lists up to two previous chemotherapy regimens and no prior bevacizumab or other VEGF-targeted treatment.
administration_text: Both on days 1 and 15; topotecan alone on day 8. All treatments are infusions in the day unit.
monitoring_summary: Blood counts before chemotherapy. Your team checks blood pressure, urine protein and organ function.
review_status: Feasibility build. Clinical, pharmacy and patient review pending.

agents.name: Bevacizumab
agents.explanation: It reduces signals that help tumours form blood vessels. This can also affect blood pressure, kidneys and wound healing.
agents.mechanism: It reduces signals that help tumours form blood vessels. This can also affect blood pressure, kidneys and wound healing.
visual: It reduces signals that help tumours form blood vessels. This can also affect blood pressure, kidneys and wound healing.
agents.watch: Call urgently for severe abdominal pain, significant bleeding, a new severe headache or sudden weakness.

agents.name: Topotecan
agents.mechanism: It blocks an enzyme cells need to copy DNA. Blood cells made in the bone marrow can also be affected.
agents.explanation: It blocks an enzyme cells need to copy DNA. Blood cells made in the bone marrow can also be affected.
visual: It blocks an enzyme cells need to copy DNA. Blood cells made in the bone marrow can also be affected.
agents.watch: Call the oncology unit immediately for fever, chills, bleeding or new breathlessness.

common_effects.title: Symptoms to record
common_effects.text: Tiredness, appetite changes and nausea can affect everyday activities. Tell the team if these limit eating, drinking or walking.

common_effects.title: Blood pressure
common_effects.text: High blood pressure may have no symptoms. Keep your blood pressure and urine checks.

serious_effects.title: Blood pressure · Bevacizumab
serious_effects.text: Blood pressure can rise without symptoms. Keep your checks. Call urgently for a severe headache or vision changes.

serious_effects.title: Bowel injury · Bevacizumab
serious_effects.text: Call urgently for severe new tummy pain, swelling or fever. A tear or abnormal connection needs immediate care.

serious_effects.title: Protein in urine · Bevacizumab
serious_effects.text: A urine test can find protein before symptoms. Report new swelling or frothy urine.

serious_effects.title: Bleeding and healing · Bevacizumab
serious_effects.text: Report wounds that reopen. Heavy bleeding, coughing blood or sudden breathlessness need urgent help.

serious_effects.title: Infection and low counts · Chemotherapy
serious_effects.text: Call the unit immediately for fever, chills, heavy bleeding or suddenly feeling unwell.

serious_effects.title: New breathlessness · Topotecan
serious_effects.text: Phone urgently about new cough or breathlessness. Infection or inflammation needs assessment.

serious_effects.title: Sore mouth · Topotecan
serious_effects.text: Use a soft toothbrush. Contact the unit if swallowing or drinking becomes difficult.

evidence.title: AURELIA
evidence.interpretation: Across the three chemotherapy choices, median time before progression was 6.7 months with bevacizumab and 3.4 months with chemotherapy alone.
evidence.limitations: These are pooled results. The study did not compare the three chemotherapy partners against each other or establish an overall survival advantage.

sections.text: Keep your hospital number on your phone and card. Discuss fertility, contraception and breastfeeding before starting.
